title: Space and shape config
description: A theme's space and shape: one option of each from space-shape-options.json. The choice becomes the default for the whole product; any subtree can still switch with data-space or data-shape. tools/space-shape.mjs builds and checks it (npm run tokens, npm run tokens:check).

space.description: How much room the product gives its content. Re-maps the space roles (inset, stack, inline, gutter, page margin); the 4 px scale, sizes and targets never change.

shape.description: How round corners are. Re-maps the radius roles (sm, md, lg, pill); shapes round by nature (radius.full) never change.
